'''''We Fight, We Win''''' was a piece of [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] created for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It depicted an [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army trooper]] standing in front of the Imperial Crest. It was featured within the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' to illustrate [[MODS System|the four principles]] required by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]: Mettle, Obedience, Discipline and Selflessness.<ref name="IHB" />
